wpts.name: Fuente Dé cable car
wpts.desc: Take the cable car with your already purchased ticket. Typically, there are two queue lines: one on the right for pre-purchased tickets and one on the left usually for those aiming to buy on-the-day tickets. We suggest joining the right-hand queue no less than 30-minutes before your entry time.
